title: Bisaya basics
about: The most common words of Bisaya (Cebuano), counted in the Cebuano web text of OPUS's NLLB collection (ODC-By 1.0) and grouped by root with tools/course/ceb/rank.mjs, most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places, and English words, are left out. Verbs are listed by their root (kaon, to eat), as Bisaya dictionaries list them. Each word has one short everyday sentence that uses it the way people in Cebu say it, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.
